summary: Energy Transfer LP filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of $1.75B aggregate principal of Series 2026A and 2026B junior subordinated notes due 2057, with interest rates of 6.550% and 6.700% respectively. The offering, underwritten by Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, and others, is expected to close July 20, 2026. Proceeds will redeem all outstanding Series H Preferred Units starting August 15, 2026, refinance debt, and for general purposes. This is a routine debt issuance and refinancing, not a special situation like a going-private or acquisition.
